items.title: Draw something calm
items.text: Sketch a place where you feel at peace: a riverbank, a terrace at dusk, your mother's kitchen. No skill needed, just a few quiet minutes.

items.title: Hum a favourite song
items.text: Hum or sing softly a song you loved as a child. Rest a hand on your belly while you do.

items.title: Three good things
items.text: Write down three things that went well today, however small.

items.title: Watch the sky
items.text: Sit by a window or step outside for five minutes. Notice the colour of the sky and the sounds around you.

items.title: A slow cup
items.text: Make a warm drink and sip it slowly, without your phone. Notice its warmth and taste.

items.title: The story of your name
items.text: Think about who chose your name and why. Write a few lines you might tell your child one day.

items.title: A small rangoli
items.text: Draw a simple rangoli or kolam pattern on paper. Let the repeating shapes slow your mind.

items.title: A happy memory
items.text: Close your eyes and recall a day you felt truly happy. Where were you? Who was with you?

items.title: Tend a plant
items.text: Water a plant, wipe its leaves, or sit near some greenery for a few minutes.

items.title: Colour a page
items.text: Colour a pattern or a picture slowly, in colours that feel soft and restful.

items.title: A family recipe
items.text: Ask an elder about a dish your family loves. Write it down to share with your child someday.

items.title: Listen to one song
items.text: Play a piece of calm music you love and simply listen, eyes closed, until it ends.

items.title: Read aloud
items.text: Read a short poem or a few lines of a favourite book aloud, slowly, as if to someone listening.

items.title: Remember a lullaby
items.text: Recall a lullaby from your family or region and hum it softly a few times.

items.title: Make something small
items.text: Knit, stitch, fold paper or shape clay. Let your hands work slowly while your mind rests.

items.title: Old photos
items.text: Look through family photos. Pick one and write down the story behind it.

items.title: A kind message
items.text: Send a short, kind message to someone you care about.

items.title: Count the sounds
items.text: Sit quietly and count the different sounds you can hear: birds, leaves, distant voices.

items.title: Your hopes
items.text: Write one hope you hold for your child, and one for yourself as a parent.

items.title: One calm corner
items.text: Tidy one small space, a shelf or a drawer, and enjoy how it looks afterwards.

items.title: Flowers or leaves
items.text: Arrange a few flowers or leaves in a bowl of water and place them where you can see them.

items.title: Describe today
items.text: Write three lines about today: the weather, a feeling, and something you noticed.

items.title: A favourite scent
items.text: Notice a scent you love: jasmine, sandalwood, fresh rain, cardamom. Breathe it in slowly.

items.title: Soft light
items.text: Spend a few minutes in gentle morning or evening light, sitting comfortably.

items.title: A picture for baby
items.text: Draw a simple picture for your baby: your home, the moon, a tree. Keep it with your letters.

items.title: Tell a story
items.text: Tell your baby a short story from your childhood, out loud or in your head.

items.title: Write a short poem
items.text: Write four short lines about this moment. They don't need to rhyme.

items.title: Five quiet minutes
items.text: Sit comfortably, let your shoulders drop, and rest in silence for five minutes.

items.title: Something to look forward to
items.text: Plan one small, pleasant thing for this week: a call, an outing with someone, a favourite meal.

items.title: Thank someone
items.text: Think of someone who helped you this week and tell them thank you, in person or in a message.
